lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Forty winters ago. The gate had stood|for sixty years, and never once opened.
lines.text: Forty winters ago. The gate had stood for sixty years, and never once opened.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Sixty winters I have kept this gate.|I can keep it one more.
lines.text: Sixty winters I have kept this gate. I can keep it one more.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Torvald. The Heartfrost hums when the|stone-men are near. It is humming now.
lines.text: Torvald. The Heartfrost hums when the stone-men are near. It is humming now.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Then the gate stays shut,|and the lake stays quiet.
lines.text: Then the gate stays shut, and the lake stays quiet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: South of the wall, the lamps of|Hearthwick went out one by one.
lines.text: South of the wall, the lamps of Hearthwick went out one by one.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: They are not coming for the lake.|Why are they not coming for the lake?
lines.text: They are not coming for the lake. Why are they not coming for the lake?

lines.speaker: rider
lines.subtitle: Lord Torvald! Open the gate!|The stone-men are in Hearthwick!
lines.text: Lord Torvald! Open the gate! The stone-men are in Hearthwick!

lines.speaker: rider
lines.subtitle: They're burning the houses.|Two hundred people, my lord. Children.
lines.text: They're burning the houses. Two hundred people, my lord. Children.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: It is bait. They want the gate open.|They want the mere.
lines.text: It is bait. They want the gate open. They want the mere.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: I know what they want.
lines.text: I know what they want.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Open the gate. All of it.
lines.text: Open the gate. All of it.

lines.speaker: rider
lines.subtitle: Thank you, my lord! I'll bring them home!
lines.text: Thank you, my lord! I'll bring them home!

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Then I hold the mere alone. Do not be long.
lines.text: Then I hold the mere alone. Do not be long.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: ...No. The gate stays shut.
lines.text: ...No. The gate stays shut.

lines.speaker: rider
lines.subtitle: You can see the smoke from|up there! You can SEE it!
lines.text: You can see the smoke from up there! You can SEE it!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The snow buried his signal fire.|Torvald watched it go out.
lines.text: The snow buried his signal fire. Torvald watched it go out.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Thank you for opening the door, frost-man.
lines.text: Thank you for opening the door, frost-man.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Keep your gate, then.|I will come up through your floor.
lines.text: Keep your gate, then. I will come up through your floor.

lines.speaker: rider
lines.subtitle: They're through! Keep it open,|the last ones are coming!
lines.text: They're through! Keep it open, the last ones are coming!

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Their door is broken. Go home, stones.
lines.text: Their door is broken. Go home, stones.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Torvald! The big one is at your gate!
lines.text: Torvald! The big one is at your gate!

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Close it now. Gently. Everyone is home.
lines.text: Close it now. Gently. Everyone is home.

lines.speaker: rider
lines.subtitle: Hearthwick will remember this gate, my lord.
lines.text: Hearthwick will remember this gate, my lord.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: The lake is safe. The lake is always safe.
lines.text: The lake is safe. The lake is always safe.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: And the town?
lines.text: And the town?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: ...Ask me in a hundred winters.
lines.text: ...Ask me in a hundred winters.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: The ice... gives...
lines.text: The ice... gives...

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Mine.
lines.text: Mine.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Cracked. Not broken.
lines.text: Cracked. Not broken.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Hearthwick still sends me bread|every midwinter. Burnt, usually.
lines.text: Hearthwick still sends me bread every midwinter. Burnt, usually.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Some nights I still see the smoke.
lines.text: Some nights I still see the smoke.
